newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Bondes rate rises at auction.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Bondes rate rises at auction.

text.p: The rate on Mexican government 729-day development bonds, or Bondes, yielded 1.31 percent above the one-month Cetes rate in Monday's primary auction, compared with 1.17 percent on 728-day Bondes last week, dealers estimated.
The 729-day Bondes were assigned at 97.85568 pesos this week.
Demand for the Bondes was 2.29 billion pesos, compared with the 900 million offered by the Banco de Mexico.
